entries.title: Community Planting and Creek Walk with Kyogle Landcare
entries.description:
Help plant trees beside Fawcetts Creek, join a guided walk and visit Kyogle Landcare Nursery during Richmond RiverFest. All ages are welcome. Bring drinking water, a hat, gloves, long trousers and enclosed footwear. Morning tea is provided; organisers may reschedule in heavy rain.

When: 9:00am–12:00pm AEDT (NSW time)
Organiser: Kyogle Council, Border Ranges–Richmond Valley Landcare Network, Landcare Kyogle Group Inc
Cost: Not published; confirm with the organiser.
Booking: Registration essential; organiser-linked registration form was accessible on 19 October 2026. No form submitted.

entries.title: Gullibul Daytime Dreaming Cultural Tour — 21 October
entries.description:
Join Gullibul Elder Michael (Wayne) Walker and language teacher Kye Walker for a bus tour exploring cultural sites, stories and connections to Country and waterways around Kyogle and Wiangaree. A picnic lunch is included. Arrive for check-in at 9:45am; the bus departs at 10am and returns about 2pm.

When: 10:00am–about 2:00pm AEDT (NSW time)
Organiser: Kyogle Council, Gugin Gudduba Local Aboriginal Land Council
Cost: AUD $10 per person plus booking fee
Booking: Booking essential; limited to 10 people per tour. Booking page returned HTTP 429 during research, so remaining places could not be confirmed.

entries.title: Picnic by the River – Richmond RiverFest Closing Event
entries.description:

Organiser: Richmond Riverkeeper, supported by Lismore Council, Rous County Council and Jagun Alliance
Cost: Picnic admission cost not specified. First guided paddle is advertised at $10 plus $0.75 booking fee; check the relevant session booking page.

Paddle bookings:
River Paddle 1: https://events.humanitix.com/river-paddle-1-riverfest-closing-event
River Paddle 2: https://events.humanitix.com/copy-of-river-paddle-2-riverfest-closing-event

entries.description:

Advance tickets required.

Organiser: Dolphin Research Australia / Ocean Education & Conservation
